|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/ewoktribesman.html</ref>

[[Ewok Tribesman]] This little fuzzy gives you one way to keep your Ewoks alive longer when the Empire is throwing around too many of those Scout-based Used destiny adders. You just need him with an Ewok of ability > 1. That means: Chirpa, [[Kazak]], [[Logray]], [[Paploo]], [[Wicket]] and [[Wuta]], and he can satisfy all your attrition woes. Add in Ewok forfeit adders like [[Teebo]] (and [[Logray]]), [[Daughter Of Skywalker]], Ithorians, Woklings and even Yub Yub, and just like the Empire did, your opponent might find these pesky natives very hard to quell!

Combo: = cover all your attrition, and get one out each deploy phase.
